description:
Silhouette Studio allows you to access or create designs and send them to a Silhouette cutting machine.

Silhouette Studio is a robust, free design software that gives makers the freedom to imagine, design, and create unique craft projects. With dozens of design tools and easy integration with Silhouette cutting machines, Silhouette Studio is the ultimate tool for crafters who want to make their own unique, personalized projects.
Changes
GENERAL
- Mac Universal build now available
- Stopped specific SVG files from crashing
- Stopped a crash when opening a specific file then opening the Send panel
- Prevented a crash that could occur on server timeouts
- Fixed a crash when the server was down for maintanence
- Fixed a potential crash on launch if diconnected from the internet
- Prevented a crash for specifc .studio3 and .ai files
- Updated the titles of the Design Store Carousels on the Home Screen
- Added missing language strings
- Fixed Japanese Translations
DESIGN
- Stopped exported PNGs from Silhouette Studio importing larger than originally exported
- Stopped the orientation from automatically changing when the height is set under 200mm
- Orientation should no longer change when the height is lower than the width
- Changed "Curio 2 (Emboss)" mat name to "Emboss Mat"
- Resolved an issue which would prevent users from adjusting the smoothing for the Smooth Freehand tool
- Fixed an import issue which could occur when importing a PDF from CAD
- You can now edit DPI settings when importing .ai files as an image
- Fixed transparency issues in certain .svg files
- Updated the margins of the cut border for the left and right edges from 5mm to 4.8mm when using either Cameo Pro Model
SEND
- Added the following firmware:
  - Portrait 4 FW1.04
  - Cameo 5 Series FW1.07
  - Cameo Pro MKII FW1.10
  - Cameo5ɑ Series FW1.04
- Updates to the Update Firmware section on Guided mode
- Updates to the Update Firmware section on Standard mode
- Fixed an issue that was causing Print and Cut jobs to perform in the wrong place on the CAMEO PRO MKII
- Resolved an issue which caused the CAMEO PRO and CAMEO PRO MKII to cut a maximum width of 596mm, it now has a maximum width of 600mm
- Changing the unit of measurement now updates all areas of the Send Screen
- Stopped CAMEO machines from being shown as "Unknown" in send
- Moved the "This can take 20 minutes to complete" message during a firmware update in standard mode to guided mode
- Fixed the no media detected dialogue box appearing when media was detected with the Auto Sheet Feeder on macOS
- The cut border does not narrow when set to landscape orientation with no mat
- Fixed Multi-cutter Support being available in Standard Edition
- Fixed a bug where the "Design is out the cut area" warning would display for certain files
- The cut job timer now works when the machine drop down is not highlighted
- Fixed the trouble connecting to machine link
- Silhouette Machines now return the stored tool separation value when connected to Silhouette Studio
- Added a scrollbar to the Tool Separation window when it is too small
- Fixed the tool separation from not being able to send negative values
- Tool separation is now applied when using the adjustment arrows
- Added labels to the calibration sliders
- Reduced software overcut from 1mm to 0.1mm
- Updated the baseplate in the Auto Sheet Feeder artwork from black to white
